body:
Source: w6 appmap-impact lane report (2026-10-11), branch claude/w6-appmap-impact 31fb799d8.

Observed: V1-1169 delivered only same-file top-level const arrays for createBrowserRouter (AMAP-V0-078); an imported array refuses `imported-react-routes`, and Rails `routes.rb` has no dialect. V1-1131 (GH #773) proposed `rails-routes/0`; if V1-1131 closes with only the React slice delivered, this ticket carries the rest.

Expected: `rails-routes/0` with literal-only fail-closed rules, and imported router arrays followed through one literal import hop.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: AMAP-V0-079 tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: appmap: rails-routes dialect and imported createBrowserRouter arrays (V1-1169 remainder)
